class: When a second code path (a background worker, a batch job, an export) rebuilds the state that an existing function already builds, instead of calling that function, the copy silently drops or defaults fields the original fills; every rule that reads a dropped field then gives a different verdict on the second path than on the first, with no error.
mechanism: GC-MU step 4 round 1: backend/ofo_app/background.py light_state (90bbcead) copied adjustment_check.state_of and set max_loss, max_profit, margin, atm_iv and prev_close to None, so a playbook trigger on max profit or max loss could fire on the screen and never in the background.

first_seen.where: GC-MU step 4 round 1 (build/gcmu-bg 90bbcead), found by the orchestrator reading the private-name guard failure
first_seen.evidence: sed of background.py:172-201 vs adjustment_check.py:140-180; test_no_order_placement flagged 5 private-name imports from the copy

fix: Round 2 (98b54260): light_state deleted; the background builds MarketInputs from the shared figures and calls the public state_of; a field-by-field equality test on ADJ-02 plus a mutant (max_profit set None) that turns it red.

detection.note: Guards this instance; the generic class (any second path) is caught only by the private-name guard when the copy imports private helpers.
